description: Fictitious support-ticket escalation with three leakage traps (target proxy, time-shifted label, high-cardinality ID).
sizingNote: 3,000 entities x 4 visible periods = 12,000 rows (Ruling Q9: >= 10,000). A fifth, hidden period per entity only feeds NextPeriodFlag and is dropped. At this size the proxy agreement (0.95) has SE 0.0020 and the nonzero betas have z-scores from 9.4 (Tier) to 42 (PrevEscalated), so leakage detection (S2/S3) is judged against clearly visible legitimate signal.
